title: Python Abstraction Quiz
description: Test your understanding of abstraction in Python classes and methods.

questions.question: What is abstraction in Python OOP?
options: Hiding implementation details and showing only functionality
questions.explanation: Abstraction hides the internal details and shows only the necessary functionality to the user.

questions.question: Which module provides support for abstract classes in Python?
questions.explanation: The `abc` module allows you to define abstract base classes and abstract methods.

questions.question: What keyword is used to declare an abstract method in Python?
questions.explanation: The `@abstractmethod` decorator from the `abc` module declares a method as abstract.

questions.question: Which of the following is TRUE about abstract classes?
options: They are the same as interfaces
They can be instantiated like normal classes
questions.explanation: Abstract classes cannot be instantiated directly and are meant to be subclassed.

questions.question: What will happen if a subclass does not implement all abstract methods?
questions.explanation: Subclasses must implement all abstract methods to be instantiable.
Subclass B implements the abstract method `show()`, so calling `B().show()` prints 'B'.

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of abstraction?
questions.explanation: Abstraction reduces code complexity by hiding implementation details and exposing only essential features.

questions.question: Can an abstract class contain non-abstract methods?
options: Only if it has no abstract methods
questions.explanation: Abstract classes can have both abstract and concrete (non-abstract) methods.

questions.question: What is the purpose of using abstract classes?
options: To provide a template for subclasses
questions.explanation: Abstract classes provide a blueprint for subclasses, enforcing implementation of abstract methods.

questions.question: Which statement is correct about abstract methods?
options: They have no implementation in the abstract class
questions.explanation: Abstract methods are declared in the abstract class without implementation and must be overridden in subclasses.
